Tout compte : scanner, ajouter des carte: Everything counts: scanning, adding cards, building and publishing decks, playing and winning games, trading, opening boosters, coming back every day, and every badge tier (bronze, silver, gold, diamond). Level 999 is meant to never be reached.

Scanne tes cartes avec l'appareil photo: Scan your cards with the camera (the round button in the middle of the bottom bar). Every copy added from the scanner counts, even over several days.
Scanne des cartes imprimées dans des lan: Scan cards printed in different languages (English, French, Japanese…). A single card is enough for a language to count.
Quand le scan lit l'édition directement: When the scanner reads the set straight from the card (the small code printed at the bottom left), it counts. Frame the bottom of the card well, in good light.
Quand le scan reconnaît l'édition grâce: When the scanner recognizes the set from the artwork or the set symbol, without being able to read the code at the bottom, it counts.
Ajoute beaucoup de cartes en une seule f: Add lots of cards in one go from the scanner: your biggest batch is what counts (every card in the list added at once).
Scanne des cartes imprimées avant 2003,: Scan cards printed before 2003, with the old frame. Every copy counts.
Scanne une carte qui vaut au moins ce mo: Scan a card worth at least this amount (reference price at the time of the scan). Your most expensive scanned card is what counts.
Plusieurs cartes portent parfois le même: Several cards sometimes share the same name (versions, special editions). When the scanner settles it using the bottom of the card or the artwork, or you pick the right one yourself, a lookalike is unmasked.
Scanne au moins 30 cartes d'une même ext: Scan at least 30 cards from the same set within 7 days of its release. Each set only counts once.
Tous les exemplaires de ta collection co: Every copy in your collection counts, however you added it: scan, search or import.
Chaque carte différente de ta collection: Each different card in your collection counts once, however many copies you own.
La valeur totale de ta collection (prix: The total value of your collection (reference prices, updated regularly) must reach this amount. It can go down if prices drop.
Chaque exemplaire foil de ta collection: Every foil copy in your collection counts. Mark it as foil when scanning or on the card's line.
Possède des cartes dans des langues diff: Own cards in different languages. Each copy's language is set when scanning or on the card's line.
Possède des cartes d'extensions différen: Own cards from different sets: a set counts as soon as one copy comes from it. Set the edition when scanning or on the card's line.
Ajoute des proxys (des impressions pour: Add proxies (printed stand-ins for playing, kept apart from your real collection). Every copy counts.
Crée des emplacements de rangement (clas: Create storage locations (binders, boxes, decks…) in the Storage tab of your collection.
Range tes cartes dans tes emplacements (: Put your cards away in your locations (“Store these cards…”, or “Store in” while scanning). Every stored copy counts.
Importe ta collection depuis une autre a: Import your collection from another app with a CSV file (ManaBox, Moxfield…).
Ajoute des cartes à tes cartes recherché: Add cards to your wanted cards (Trade section). Each different card counts.
Crée ou importe des decks. Chaque deck e: Create or import decks. Every saved deck counts, built or not.
Allume « Deck monté » sur un deck : ses: Turn on “Built deck” on a deck: its cards are reserved in your collection. Every built deck counts.
Publie tes decks pour la communauté (con: Publish your decks for the community (signing in to an account required). Every published deck counts.
Joue des parties du compteur de vie avec: Play life counter games with different commanders: each commander set on your seat counts once.
Joue des parties avec le compteur de vie: Play games with the life counter (home screen card). Every finished game where you have a seat counts.
Gagne des parties du compteur de vie : l: Win life counter games: the winner is set at the end of the game.
Gagne une partie après être tombé à 5 po: Win a game after dropping to 5 life or less during it. Counted on the phone that started the game.
Élimine des adversaires aux blessures de: Eliminate opponents with commander damage (21 damage from the same commander). Counted on the phone that started the game.
Gagne plusieurs parties avec le même dec: Win several games with the same deck: your most victorious deck is what counts.
Enchaîne les victoires sans perdre entre: Win games in a row without losing in between: your best streak is what counts.
Gagne une partie en 6 tours ou moins (le: Win a game in 6 turns or fewer (the game's turn counter decides).
Termine une partie qui a duré plus de 2: Finish a game that lasted more than 2 hours.
Play a game with 6 or more players.

Fais des échanges en direct avec d'autre: Make live trades with other players (Live trade) and confirm them all the way.
Ajoute des amis dans Mana Orbit (connexi: Add friends in Mana Orbit (signing in to an account required). Every friend counts.
Crée le lien de ta liste d'échange (cart: Create your trade list link (Trade card on the home screen) to share it.
Fais des sessions d'ouverture de booster: Run booster opening sessions (from the scan settings) and finish them.

Ouvre une carte qui vaut au moins ce mon: Open a card worth at least this amount during an opening session. Your best opened card is what counts.
Joue la Carte mystère du jour (ses icône: Play the daily Mystery card (its icons in the header). Every day played counts, checked by the server.
Joue la Carte mystère plusieurs jours de: Play the Mystery card several days in a row without skipping one: your best streak is what counts.
Finis dans les 100 premiers du classemen: Finish in the top 100 of the daily Mystery card leaderboard (in timed mode).
Finis premier du classement du jour de l: Finish first on the daily Mystery card leaderboard (in timed mode).
Trouve la Carte mystère dès le premier i: Find the Mystery card on the very first clue, before the second one is revealed.

Va jusqu'au bout de la visite guidée (Co: Go all the way through the guided tour (Account and settings › Help and feedback › Guided tour).
